summary: Address deletion, Christmas offer and nearest store
description: Deleting an address asks for confirmation. The Christmas offer is active until 24 December 2026 12:00 UTC. The offer page finds the nearest store from the shopper's location.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting an address asks Delete this address?; cancelling keeps it, confirming removes it.
The offer page shows Offer active before 24 December 2026 12:00 UTC and Offer ended after it.
With the location allowed, a shopper in Warsaw gets Warsaw as the nearest store.
